name: com.kovapi/docs
title: KovAPI Docs
description: Search and read the KovAPI API docs as Markdown and list its models with prices. Read-only, no key.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the KovAPI API documentation: guide pages and sections, every model doc, endpoints, integrations and the FAQ. Returns titles with URLs; read one with read_doc.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "image to image", "webhook signature", "429".

lang.description: Language of the docs to search (default en).

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Return one KovAPI documentation page as Markdown. Pass a path or URL, e.g. /docs/api, /docs/nano-banana-2, /docs/guide/errors, /docs/integrations/claude-code, /docs-guide, /docs/webhooks, or a docs.kovapi.com URL. A language prefix (/zh /en /es /ja /ko /ru) picks the language; the bare path is the site default.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: Every model on sale at KovAPI with its id, name, vendor, category and USD price, plus the link to its API doc (Markdown).
